name: Bravecto Plus 2.8-6.25kg Cat Flea Tick & Worm Pipette 2PK
description:
If you reside in a paralysis tick area, treat your cat every 2 months.
If you do not reside in a paralysis tick area, treat your cat every 3 months.

A single dose of Bravecto Plus for Cats provides:
Treatment and prevention of flea infestations for 3 months.
Treatment and control of paralysis tick for 10 weeks.
Rapid onset of action kills newly emerged adult fleas before they lay eggs.
Reduces incidence of flea allergy dermatitis (FAD) by controlling fleas.
Prevention of heartworm disease when administered at intervals of 3 months.
Treatment and control of roundworm and hookworm.
Treatment and control of ear mites.

Bravecto Plus for Cats should not be used on kittens less than 9 weeks of age or cats weighing less than 1.2kg.

How to apply / administer product 
1. Remove Bravecto from child safe packaging.
2. Hold the tube straight up and give cap one twist to break the seal.
3. Remember: The cap does not come off!
4. Ensure the animal's back is horizontal. Part the hair apply directly to the skin.
5. For cats <6.25kg apply in one spot. For cats >6.25kg apply in two spot. 
Remember: To apply at the base of the skull to ensure the wet product can't be licked.
